answer_1.quote: Abstractive multi-document summarization (MDS) aims to generate coherent and concise summaries from sets of related documents.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate summary informativeness with ROUGE and BertScore, coherence with DiscoScore, faithfulness with our new MDSummaC metric, and abstractiveness with Ngram Novelty.

answer_4.quote: Human Evaluation We validate our results through human evaluation, following in evaluating both summary fluency and faithfulness.
answer_4.guideline: For Grammaticality, Referential Clarity, and Structure & Coherence, we report the average ranking when comparing methods. For Faithfulness, we report the percentage of system-generated SCUs that are holistically entailed by human-verified input SCUs.
